_notes.why_absolute_paths: Unlike Isaac-GR00T_n1d7 (which sits under the IsaacLab-GR00T root evalbot's workspace.yaml marker resolves against), RLDX-1 lives as a SIBLING checkout at /data/VLA/tingying/RLDX-1, one level up. A ROOT-relative path here would resolve to <root>/RLDX-1, which doesn't exist. Absolute paths bypass resolve_path()'s ROOT resolution entirely.
_notes.port: 5556, not 5555, so an RLDX-1 run can sit alongside a GR00T server without a port clash (matches the main configs/rldx1_openarm_o6.json).
